question: Can the V3 repository and experiment workflow prevent unapproved data use, strict-test leakage, cross-Gate execution, and result overwrites before research experiments resume?
method: Incremental repository scaffold plus deterministic standard-library governance checks and automated negative tests.
baseline: Documentation-only governance with manual directory naming and no executable preflight checks.

user_authorization.scope: Create the V3 repository scaffold, governance tools, legacy indexes, tests, and Gate-0 evidence without data export, training, or simulation.

acceptance_criteria: A valid Gate-0 infrastructure run passes preflight and creates the standard evidence layout without executing its command.
A run targeting a non-current Gate is rejected.
A data-dependent operation without an approved data card is rejected.
Any strict-test world overlap with development, SSL, normalization, calibration, augmentation, or checkpoint selection is rejected.
An existing result directory is never overwritten.
expected_evidence: Repository structure and experiment protocol documents
Legacy code/result maps and failure knowledge base
Automated test report and machine-readable summary

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only governance unit tests; no dataset, model, GPU, ROS, or simulator
